data.description: As a standard action, a myrmidon can fire a rocket to a range of 8oo feet. A rocket explodes on impact in a 30-foot-radius burst, dealing 6d6 points of fire damage and 6d6 points of bludgeoning damage to all creatures in the area (Reflex DC 18 halves).
